document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You outdistance the tiny hunters, but when you finally pause for 
breath, you are quite alone. You do not know whether Norman 
and Sylvia also got away, or where they ended up. Can you 
locate the lost students?
Make a Luck roll: if you succeed, go to 316; if you fail, go to 67.
